args.lesson: Area-critical sin/cos (>=1 MSPS, err <= 2^-10): the iterative family dominates. Best min-area point is iterative:data_width=15,n_iter=15,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=round -> luts_plus_ffs=257 (166 LUTs + 91 FFs), err 2^-10.27, 11 MSPS. Adding angle_guard=1 / frac_guard=1-2 buys accuracy bits (up to 2^-12.3) at +12..+36 LUT+FF cost. Pipelined/unrolled families were not on the min-area front. Note: L3 verify_rtl and L4 synthesize returned no recorded rows for this design class (W=15 exhaustive run too heavy), and L5 back_annotate returned no_measured_data -> no winner change, no reexplore. So the L1 cost-model estimate is the only characterization available; don't expect measured data for this spec.
